title: Map of reported flying object sightings as of 1 August 1948 (Appendix B)
description: Photographed map of the United States, shown rotated on the page, with clusters of dot markers indicating reported sightings of flying objects. The page is headed "APPENDIX 'B' — REPORTED SIGHTINGS OF FLYING OBJECTS AS OF 1 AUGUST 1948" and includes a legend strip along the right edge of the map. Part of a 1948 USAF Air Intelligence Report on flying objects.
